beats.text: OpenAI's new model can open apps on your computer, click through them, and finish a task while you watch.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: It's called GPT-6 Astra. And right now, it's one of the most searched AI tools in India.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: But most people hit the same wall. They open ChatGPT, look for Astra, and it simply isn't there.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: So let's decode it: where Astra hides, how to switch it on, what it costs in India, and the free Astra trap. Stay for that one, it's catching a lot of people.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: GPT-6 Astra is OpenAI's top model, launched in September twenty twenty-six, built for computer work, coding and long, demanding tasks.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: On November seventeenth, OpenAI upgraded it to GPT-6.2 Astra, and added a cheaper sister model called Sol.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: Think of it like this. Sol is your fast, everyday assistant. Astra is the specialist you call for the hardest jobs.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: Our host Max had a big plan. Ask Astra to do his entire job, then take the afternoon off.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: He opened ChatGPT. No Astra. He refreshed. Still no Astra. He blamed his Wi-Fi.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: The Wi-Fi was fine. Astra just doesn't live where most people look.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: On the Plus plan, Astra sits inside two places: ChatGPT Work and Codex. Not the regular chat list.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: On the Free and Go plans, it isn't included at all. Pro and business plans get it too, with much higher limits.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: And even on Plus, there's a limit. OpenAI estimates roughly five to forty-five Astra messages every five hours, depending on the task.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: So treat it like a precious resource. Big jobs only, not "write me a birthday message".
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: Before anything else, check which plan you're on in your ChatGPT settings. That decides everything.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: Here's how to switch it on. Step one: install the ChatGPT desktop app, on Windows or Mac, and update it.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: Step two: at the top, switch from Chat to Work. Then pick Astra from the model menu.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: Step three, the exciting part. Open Plugins, find Computer Use, install it and turn it on.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: On a Mac, allow Screen Recording and Accessibility. On Windows, keep the app you want it to use visible on screen.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: Step four: start your request with "at Computer" for desktop apps, or "at Chrome" for jobs in your browser.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: Then say exactly what done looks like. For example: "Open my sales sheet, chart the monthly totals, and save it as a PDF on my desktop."
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: Before it touches any app, ChatGPT asks your permission. And you can watch every click, and stop it any time.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: It can't see your screen or use an app unless you allow it. You stay in control.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: One catch. A Work task started on the website or the phone app runs in the cloud. It can't reach the files on your own computer.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: So Max tried again, properly this time. And people are using Astra for jobs like these.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: A folder of receipts, turned into one tidy expense sheet.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: A simple website built from a sketch, then opened in the browser to check it really works.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: Even 3D apps like Blender. Researchers built a whole test, called BlenderWorld, to measure how well AI agents create 3D scenes.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: And for coders, pick Astra inside Codex, and it can work through a whole project, run the tests and fix what breaks.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: It can also create real files, like documents, spreadsheets and presentations, not just text in a chat window.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: And through the API, it can read about a million tokens at once. That's a few thick books in one go.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: So, how good is it? On a computer-use test called OSWorld two point oh, OpenAI reports Astra finished about seventy-three percent of tasks.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: The previous top model managed about sixty-six percent, and took roughly seventy-five minutes per task, against about forty for Astra.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: That's OpenAI's own testing, so treat it as a strong claim, not a guarantee.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: OpenAI's launch chart even ranks Astra above Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2. Again, that's OpenAI's own chart.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: And it isn't instant. Big tasks can take many minutes. It's for jobs you'd hand to an assistant, not quick questions.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: Quick game. Astra or Sol? I give you a job, you pick the model.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: Summarise a long email. Sol. Fast and cheap is perfect.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: Go through fifty invoices on your computer and fill a spreadsheet. Astra. That's real computer work.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: Fix a bug across a big codebase. Astra, or Sol on a budget. OpenAI says Sol nearly matches Astra on ready-to-merge code, at about a fifth of the cost.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: A birthday message for your friend. Please. Use Sol. Save Astra for the hard stuff.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: Now, the money question for India. ChatGPT Go costs three hundred and ninety-nine rupees a month, but it doesn't include Astra.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: Plus is about one thousand nine hundred and ninety-nine rupees a month in India, including GST. That's the cheapest way to get Astra.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: For many students that's a big monthly bill. If you mostly need help with writing and study, the free models or Go will do just fine.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: Prices change, so always check the official pricing page before you pay.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: For developers, the API costs eight dollars per million input tokens for Astra, and forty dollars out.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: Sol is two dollars in and ten out. So Astra costs about four times as much.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: Now, the trap I promised. "GPT-6 Astra free" is one of the biggest searches in India right now, and scammers follow the searches.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: Websites and APK files promising free, unlimited Astra are a classic way to steal your account and card details.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: The only safe places are chatgpt.com, the official ChatGPT apps and OpenAI's own API. If a deal sounds too good, it is.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: And here's a warning from OpenAI itself. Astra is its first model rated "Critical" for cybersecurity, under its own safety framework.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: That means it could find serious security holes with very little human help. So OpenAI watches its tasks, and can pause them mid-run.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: OpenAI even admits Astra is harder to monitor than its previous model. That's why it watches it so closely.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: For you, the lesson is simple. Give Astra only the apps and files a task really needs.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: Five quick tips before you start.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: One. Give it the full picture. The goal, the files, and what finished looks like.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: Two. Never let it near banking apps, passwords or payment pages.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: Three. Break huge jobs into stages, and check after each one.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: Four. Use Sol for small things, so your Astra limit lasts.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: Five. Check its work. Even the smartest model can be confidently wrong.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: So, did Max get his afternoon off? Partly. Astra built his report while he watched, and he spent the time he saved checking it.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: GPT-6 Astra isn't magic, and it isn't free. But if your work lives on a computer, it can save you hours.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: Tell me in the comments: what's the first job you'd hand to Astra?
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: And subscribe to TechDecoded with Max for more tech, decoded.
beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace
